map.输入精度等级、载荷与转速，计算精密轴承 L10 额定寿命与精度保持寿命: Enter accuracy grade, load and speed to compute L10 rated life and accuracy-holding life of precision bearings
map.L₁₀ = (C/P)^p（ISO 281），并计精度因子与润滑因子: L10 = (C/P) to the p (ISO 281), also counting accuracy factor and lubrication factor
map.基于 ISO 281 的 L10 额定寿命公式，结合精度等级因子（P0–P2）与: Based on the ISO 281 L10 rated life formula, combined with accuracy grade factor (P0 to P2) and lubrication method factor, compute the fatigue life and accuracy-holding period of precision bearings.
map.💡 L10=(C/P)^p×10⁶/(60n)；精度因子：P4×1.2，P2×1: L10 = (C/P) to the p times 1e6 / (60 n); accuracy factor: P4 times 1.2, P2 times 1.5; accuracy-holding life = L10 times accuracy factor times lubrication factor
map.P4/P2级用于机床主轴、精密仪器等高回转精度场合: P4/P2 grades are used for machine tool spindles, precision instruments and other high rotational accuracy applications
map.精度保持寿命通常低于疲劳寿命，因沟道磨损导致精度丧失: Accuracy-holding life is usually lower than fatigue life because groove wear causes loss of accuracy
map.油雾/喷射润滑可显著延长精密轴承寿命: Oil mist / injection lubrication can significantly extend precision bearing life
map.📚 深度解析：精密轴承寿命（L10 与精度保持寿命）: In-depth: Precision Bearing Life (L10 and accuracy-holding life)
map.：由 C、P 与转速算 L10 疲劳寿命: : compute L10 fatigue life from C, P and speed
map.精度保持评估：结合精度等级与润滑方式折算精度保持寿命: Accuracy-holding evaluation: convert accuracy-holding life by accuracy grade and lubrication method
map.工况校核：看载荷比与 dn 值是否越界: Condition check: see whether load ratio and dn value exceed limits
map.算法：球轴承取 p=3，L10 转数 = (C/P)³×1e6；L10 小时 =: Algorithm: ball bearing takes p = 3, L10 revolutions = (C/P) cubed times 1e6; L10 hours = L10 revolutions / (60 times speed); accuracy-holding life = L10 hours times accuracy grade factor times lubrication factor (grade P0 1.0, P6 1.05, P5 1.1, P4 1.2, P2 1.5; grease 0.8, oil bath 1.0, oil mist 1.3, injection 1.5); load ratio = P / C times 100%; dn value = speed times 25 (estimated by inner diameter 25 mm); greater than or equal to 30000 h excellent, greater than or equal to 15000 h good, greater than or equal to 5000 h medium, otherwise poor; load ratio greater than 20% prompts to enlarge the size, dn value greater than 500000 prompts high-speed lubrication.
map.例：P4 精密级、脂润滑、C=20kN、P=3kN、5000rpm → L10: Example: P4 precision grade, grease lubrication, C = 20 kN, P = 3 kN, 5000 rpm gives L10 revolutions 2.963e8, L10 life 987.7 h, accuracy-holding life 948.1 h (0.11 years), load ratio 15%, dn value 125000, rated poor, prompts to enlarge the size or reduce speed. Switch to P2 grade, oil bath lubrication, C = 30 kN, P = 2 kN, 3000 rpm gives L10 life 18750 h, accuracy-holding life 28125 h (3.21 years), load ratio 6.7%, dn value 75000, rated good.
map.L10 指同一批轴承中 90% 在疲劳剥落前能达到或超过的寿命（10% 失效寿命: L10 means the life that 90% of a batch of bearings can reach or exceed before fatigue spalling (10% failure life); it is a baseline for selection comparison, not a guaranteed life; actual life is also affected by lubrication, contamination and installation accuracy.
map.精度保持寿命为什么可以高于 L10？: Why can accuracy-holding life be higher than L10?
map.高精度等级（P2 因子 1.5）与良好润滑（喷射 1.5）会延长精度保持能力，使: High accuracy grade (P2 factor 1.5) and good lubrication (injection 1.5) extend the accuracy-holding ability, making the converted value higher than L10; but once fatigue spalling occurs, accuracy is quickly lost, so the two should be viewed together.
